insights.insight: Ad tech charges $5–$150 CPA for modeled attribution; this protocol settles verified purchase confirmation at roughly $0.10 per receipt — a 50–200x cost delta that is structural, not a promotional rate.

insights.topic: Verified GMV as proof-of-purchase signal layer
insights.insight: 7,409 cryptographically verified receipts represent 7,409 confirmed purchase events, not inferred intent — the foundational distinction cookieless targeting alternatives have struggled to replicate at scale.

insights.topic: Brand universe expansion across the full retail stack
insights.insight: The top brand list has migrated from big-box (Walmart) through specialty (Total Wine) and online marketplaces (Amazon, Etsy) to peer-to-peer resale (Depop now ranks above Best Buy by receipt count), confirming the verified signal set spans the complete purchase funnel, not a single retail vertical.

The 7-day GMV window moved from $24K to $56K in roughly 120 hours — a more-than-doubling of weekly run rate — while acceleration has held above 1.0x for 15+ consecutive measurement cycles, indicating compounding submission growth, not a one-time spike.

141 receipts classified as 'Unknown' carry an average ticket of ~$92 — the highest of any category in the 14-day window — meaning category resolution here would materially shift the retail vs. services attribution split for any brand targeting on basket size.

insights.topic: Digital-native purchase confirmation as primary receipt vector
insights.insight: DKIM vendors include Amazon, Stripe, Paddle, Gumroad, Anthropic, OpenAI variants, and Suno, confirming that email-based purchase confirmations from SaaS and digital commerce are a primary data ingestion channel — relevant for brands targeting software buyers and early adopters.
